description: App-crash survival of the app's children in the daemon (appChildrenInDaemon on, app-crash-survival.py): a 60 s shell-mode command and the inline VS Code server, then SIGKILL of the app and a relaunch on the same tag; the command still runs and its output continues by offset, VS Code keeps its URL, and after a clean quit process-model-census.py finds no app child left under the daemon.
